line.en: the busan illustration fair runs 6 to 8 nov at bexco, exhibition center 2, hall 4. go in the afternoon; check the hours on the official page first.
line.de: die busan illustration fair läuft vom 6. bis 8. november im bexco, ausstellungszentrum 2, halle 4. am nachmittag hingehen; die öffnungszeiten vorher auf der offiziellen seite prüfen.
line.tr: busan illustration fair 6-8 kasım'da bexco'da, sergi merkezi 2, salon 4'te. öğleden sonra git; saatleri önce resmi sayfadan kontrol et.

sparks.why: Busan Illustration Fair at BEXCO Exhibition Center 2, Hall 4, 6 to 8 Nov 2026, per BEXCO's events page and the visitkorea and ktriptips listings; the edition label (V.6 or V.7) differs between sources, so the hours are left to the venue page.
